Unique Artifact. The result of the interaction between the Crystal Barb and the Meatgrinder. Rarely appears in clusters of anomalies.
AAC with "Toad's Eye"

Born in the anomaly "Trumplin". Such an artifact can be found in few areas of the Zone. Inclusions of metallic compounds give a beautiful play of light. Looking at this artifact in the light of a fire at night is wonderfully soothing.
AAC with "Glass Bagel"
Appears in clusters of anomalies. Protects against unconsciousness, restores strength, shields against psi effects.
Formed by the Roast anomaly at high temperatures. Appears as a blackened drop-shaped formation with a glossy surface, covered with cracks.

Superartefact of an electromagnetic nature. A directional field of disintegration. The origin of this item is shrouded in a veil of scientific mystery. It is clear that it includes dielectric elements, but under what physical conditions it is formed - science is unknown. Allows you to carry an additional 4 kg.
Wearing this artifact denaturalizes proteins more slowly. In other words, the flesh is more resistant to high temperatures and burns less. In itself, it is an expensive and rare item.
Superartefact of the second level. Appears in clusters of anomalies. Anomalous energy level: very high. Cost: very high. Prevalence: very low.
AAC with "Dead Head"
This artifact is so rare that many researchers have no idea that such a substance could even exist in the wild. It rejects caustic chemical components.

Superartefact with unstable gravity. A throwable object is "shot" into a living body after hitting the floor or an obstacle. Once hit, it is "shot" into the next living body until it falls or hits a non-living object. The artifact can then be picked up.
AAC with "Sponge"
Big flying fluff, leaves severe burns when it hits the body. It accumulates in lowlands, pits, and hollows. Rises into the air in wind or explosions. It comes out of a buildup of "Stinging Fluff".
AAC with "Stinging absorbent cotton"
A congenital case of Electra anomaly activity. Apparently, such a wonderful rounded shape can be obtained by subjecting the anomaly to thermal effects. An expensive artifact.
AAC with "Electric Ball"
Located near Electra-type anomalies. A fairly common and inexpensive artifact. Nevertheless, it is valued among the researchers of the Zone for its properties.
AAC with "Mercury"

Artefact of electrical origin. A transparent, shimmering sphere.

Crystallizes in the Stinging Fluff anomaly. Draws radiation out of the body naturally. That is, through the ears along with a certain amount of blood. Possible blood loss through other orifices as well. Occurs infrequently and is quite effective, which has earned it a stable price on the artifact market.
The Stinging Fluff anomaly very rarely spawns such an artifact. Increases blood pressure, body gets rid of large amounts of red blood cells. Temporarily shields against psi effects.

The result of the interaction between the Stinging Fluff anomaly and the body of an inattentive stalker. The spiky artifact prickles the wearer's body no matter how it is attached. But it also helps cleanse the body of radionuclides. Quite common and cheap.
It is very rare to find near Carousel anomalies. Only a few people manage to find such an artifact, and few people have even seen it. It has a nice shape and an equally nice price.

Found near anomalies of the Vortex type. On contact with the body, it emits directed radiation that increases chemical resistance. It is easy to find, so it fetches little money. It allows the bearer to carry additional cargo.

The artefact consists of several connected hollow organic formations. When used, it releases a gas that neutralises chemical or toxic particles in the human body. Its temperature remains constant regardless of storage conditions, allowing it to absorb heat and create a thermal barrier around itself and its bearer that protects against chemical exposure. However, it puts great strain on the bearer’s nervous system, making shock especially dangerous. Stalkers who used it in areas with strong electric fields report quickly losing their sense of direction and panicking; they could only scream as loudly as possible, yet could not hear their own cries. Like the Bracelet, it also emits caustic vapours.
